body:
Adderall & Alcohol & Melatonin
I've been taking melatonin semi-regularly over the last week and on days I've skipped I still had the rememberable dream experience the same as when I took it, so I believe there is a delayed release effect that came into play here even though I did not take melatonin this time.
I had two wine coolers prior to taking two dextroamp-amphetamine 5mg tabs and another immediately after, which seems to have moderated the effect.
After about an hour I felt a slight up. This was the totality of the amphetamine effect as it is normally understood. What's really interesting is that I fell asleep easily at the 4 hour mark, just when it should have been at its highest. However, I woke up repeatedly, at least several times an hour, all through the night. I also had the rememberable dream experience in between.
This morning I feel particularly refreshed and alert despite being long after the effects should have worn off and having gotten only about 5-6 hours of very interrupted sleep. I can't anticipate how these substances were effecting my experience specifically since I've had speed before but not Adderall. I think this was a unique experience and worth putting down.
